reasoning_content: The Android plugin is not found. This is because the project needs the Capacitor Android library reference. Let me fix the settings.gradle to properly include Capacitor.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check what Capacitor files exist
c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/client/node_modules/@capacitor/android/")

# Fix settings.gradle properly
c.exec_command("""echo 'pluginManagement {
    repositories {
        google()
        mavenCentral()
        gradlePluginPortal()
    }
}
include ":app"
project(":app").projectDir = new File("app")
' > /opt/areloria/client/android/settings.gradle""")

c.close()
EOF
